page.layout: One printed page. Top: page number at upper left and running head "CALENDARIUM" with subtitle "Mensis undecimus." centred above the table. Main block: a calendar table with columns of year and month labels at left, a "Dies." column of day numbers, a column of letters and feast notes (A B, di. 30.), and a right-hand column of notes on events. Below the table at lower right: "IVDAIC." as a catchword-like running label.

main_text.head: CALENDARIUM Mensis undecimus.
main_text.l: 1637. | | 11. A B di. 30. | Quintus in anno sacro. Characterē habet hoc anno 4. 8. 1074.
20 | 9 | Iejunium. | 9. Decretum contra Iudæos ne ingrederentur in terram Iudæam. Desolatio templi prioris & posterioris.
29 | 18 | Iejunium. Sabb. | 18. Extincta est lucerna vespertina in diebus Ahaz.

page.notes: Faint show-through from the reverse page (ghosted calendar figures and text in the upper left and right, and the faint "CALEX" mark at lower left) is not transcribed. The table is set with rules; the Dies column lists days 1 to 30, and the reading of the leftmost month labels follows the scan. Marginal right-hand notes are placed beside their table rows as printed.
